summary.headline: The Planning Board elected new leadership and recommended issuing an occupancy permit for 200 Turnpike Road with a $30,000 performance bond.
summary.summary: The Planning Board reorganized its officers, electing a new chair and vice chair, and appointed representatives to various committees. The board discussed an occupancy permit request for 200 Turnpike Road, recommending issuance conditioned on completing landscaping and slope stabilization backed by a $30,000 bond. Several public hearings on Route 9 projects were continued to June 22, and the town planner gave updates on Costco permitting and drainage adjustments at Valvoline.

topics.title: Board reorganization and committee appointments
topics.summary: Following the departure of the former chair and the addition of a new member, the board held annual reorganization elections and made annual appointments to town committees. Member Lisa Braccio was elected chair, and member Deb DeMuria was elected vice chair. The board also voted to renew committee representations for the coming year.
key_details: Lisa Braccio elected chair by a 5-0 vote.
Deb DeMuria elected vice chair by a 5-0 vote.
All current members of the Master Plan Implementation Committee were reappointed for one-year terms.
Deb DeMuria appointed primary representative and Alan Belniak alternate to the MetroWest Regional Collaborative for one-year terms.
Lisa Braccio and Marnie Hoolahan appointed to the Deed Research Subcommittee for one-year terms.
topics.outcome: New board officers elected and committee representatives appointed.

topics.title: 40-42 Central Street litigation status
topics.summary: The chair announced an upcoming executive session regarding 40-42 Central Street with town counsel. The board will meet on Thursday, June 4 at 6:30 PM via Zoom, opening briefly in public before immediately entering executive session.
key_details: Executive session scheduled for Thursday, June 4 at 6:30 PM via Zoom.
Board will open and immediately enter executive session without returning to open session.

topics.title: 200 Turnpike Road occupancy permit and as-built review
topics.summary: The board reviewed as-built plans and an occupancy permit request from CMJ Ventures LLC for a contractor and landscaping business facility at 200 Turnpike Road. While peer review engineers found the building and civil site elements compliant, landscaping and rain garden plantings had experienced winter die-off and an embankment slope had experienced erosion. The applicant agreed to post a $30,000 performance bond, eliminate an unnecessary outdoor dumpster pad in favor of internal storage, install replacement plantings by October 1, 2026, and participate in a one-year follow-up inspection in fall 2027.
key_details: Property address: 200 Turnpike Road (contractor facility and landscaping business).
Dumpster enclosure eliminated; commercial trash will be handled through indoor totes and private hauling.
Required plantings and slope stabilization must be completed by October 1, 2026.
Applicant to provide a $30,000 performance bond to guarantee landscaping completion.
A follow-up inspection will take place by October 1, 2027 to ensure plant survival and slope stability.
topics.outcome: The board voted 5-0 to recommend that the building inspector issue a certificate of occupancy subject to the landscaping deadline, slope stabilization, one-year look-back, and a $30,000 performance bond.
topics.why_it_matters: Ensures site plan compliance and environmental protections, including stormwater basin landscaping and slope erosion controls, are completed and financially secured for commercial developments along Route 9.

topics.title: 96 Mount Vickery Road surety update
topics.summary: The town planner gave an administrative update that town counsel and the developer's attorney are finalizing the surety agreement and bond for 96 Mount Vickery Road as requested by the town's consulting engineer.
key_details: Surety agreement and bond are undergoing final legal review.
Matter will be placed on the next Planning Board agenda for formal action.
topics.outcome: Item continued to the next meeting without testimony.

topics.title: 22 Turnpike Road (Golf Range) hearing continuation
topics.summary: The applicant for 22 Turnpike Road requested a continuance of the public hearing and an extension of the statutory deadline for board action on the major site plan approval modification.
key_details: Statutory deadline for board action extended to July 17, 2026.
Public hearing continued to June 22, 2026 at 6:45 PM.
topics.outcome: Continuance and deadline extension approved unanimously 5-0.

topics.title: 154 Turnpike Road hearing continuation
topics.summary: The applicant for 154 Turnpike Road requested to continue the public hearing for a major site plan modification and extend the deadline for board action.
key_details: Public hearing continued to June 22, 2026 at 7:00 PM.
Deadline for board action extended to July 17, 2026.
topics.outcome: Continuance and deadline extension approved unanimously 5-0.

topics.title: Subdivision rules and regulations update
topics.summary: Board member Alan Belniak reported meeting with the town planner and Department of Public Works staff to advance updates to the town's subdivision rules and regulations, with draft materials anticipated before the next meeting.
key_details: Working group consists of board member Alan Belniak, the town planner, and DPW staff.
Draft revisions will be prepared for board discussion at a future meeting.

topics.title: Planning Board role in zoning enforcement
topics.summary: The chair noted that the board is awaiting policy feedback regarding its role in zoning enforcement and will reach out to schedule a discussion to bring back to the board.
key_details: Chair will follow up with town officials to gather information for the next meeting.

topics.title: Town planner report: Valvoline, Costco, and Select Board goal setting
topics.summary: The town planner reported on several town projects. At 361 Turnpike Road (Valvoline), a minor field change was approved to shift underground drainage slightly around ledge rock. The Costco project team has applied to the Zoning Board of Appeals for variances regarding light pole heights and retaining wall setbacks, and town counsel advised that the town bylaw 10 percent traffic increase standard functions as a scoping guideline rather than a strict mathematical requirement. The planner also noted the Select Board's annual goal-setting session scheduled for June 8.
key_details: 361 Turnpike Road: Minor field shift in drainage approved by town engineers due to ledge.
Costco: Applied to ZBA for variances for light poles and retaining wall setbacks; ZBA hearing targeted for July 15, 2026.
Costco traffic: Town counsel advised the 10 percent traffic increase bylaw threshold is a planning guideline rather than an absolute cap.
Select Board goal-setting meeting is scheduled for June 8, 2026 at the Public Safety Building.
The board submitted a letter of support to EOHLC for Westborough's regional One Stop grant application.
topics.outcome: Informational updates shared with the board.

topics.title: Routine business
topics.summary: The board approved minutes from prior meetings as amended and adjourned.
key_details: Minutes of April 27, 2026 approved 3-0-2 as amended (Alan Belniak and Tom Trong abstaining).
Minutes of May 11, 2026 approved 4-0-1 as amended (Tom Trong abstaining).
Minutes of May 21, 2026 approved 4-0-1 (Tom Trong abstaining).
